fields.Name: T233 - Credentials Audit Timeline Detail
fields.Description: Date-grouped timeline with expandable accordion rows that JSON-parse the audit event's Details into IP/duration/credential-id fields — a bespoke audit view, not the generic grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose 'Credentials', then open the 'Audit Log' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Above the log, stats cards (Total Events, Successful, Failed, Unique Users) should render. The default view is a timeline grouped by date (Today / Yesterday / etc.). Verify the timeline renders (or a valid 'No credential access events' empty state). If events exist, expand one timeline entry via its accordion and confirm it reveals parsed detail rows (e.g., IP Address, Duration, Credential ID). If there are no events, the empty state alone is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: Stats cards (Total Events, Successful, Failed, Unique Users) render
A date-grouped timeline renders OR a valid 'No credential access events' empty state appears
When events exist, expanding a timeline entry reveals parsed detail fields (IP Address / Duration / Credential ID / etc.)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
